Short Company Description
 We are a full-cycle software development company delivering high-performing solutions and services designed to answer the specific needs of each of our clients. We are specialized in data management web, mobile and BI applications based on Microsoft or IBM technologies, on cloud or on-premise.
 Requirements
 We are looking for a Developer with a strong technical background and solid SQL skills to join
our team.
The role will primarily involve working with data, business applications, and reporting solutions.
Experience with IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 and IBM Cognos Analytics is considered a plus,
as the project is mainly focused on these technologies. Experience with Power BI would also be
an advantage, as there may be opportunities to work on Power BI-related tasks.
